# Photok

> Photok is a private photo vault for Android and iOS. It encrypts photos and videos on-device with AES-256 and requires no account and no cloud upload. The core of the Android app is open source under the Apache License 2.0. Optional premium features are available as "Photok Pro" via a one-time in-app purchase on Google Play.

Key facts:

- **Slogan:** A safe place for your photos.
- **What it is:** a mobile app for Android and iOS (Android package id `dev.leonlatsch.photok`) that stores photos and videos in an encrypted local vault.
- **Encryption:** AES-256. Files are decrypted only in memory while the app is in use; they are never written unprotected to disk.
- **Privacy model:** no account, no cloud upload, no ads. Media never leaves the device.
- **Analytics:** privacy-friendly, anonymized analytics via TelemetryDeck — disabled by default in open-source builds (F-Droid, GitHub), enabled by default in the Google Play and iOS builds. Never used for advertising or cross-app tracking.
- **License:** Apache License 2.0 for the core of the Android app. The Google Play build may include additional proprietary Photok Pro components not covered by that license.
- **Author:** Leon Latsch, Germany. Contact: hello@photok.app
- **Availability:** Apple App Store (iOS); Google Play, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, GitHub Releases (Android).
- **Backups:** work across platforms; an Android backup can be restored on iOS and vice versa.
- **Languages:** community-translated into 13 languages.
- **Source code (Android):** https://github.com/leonlatsch/Photok

## Features

- Private gallery — import photos and videos into an encrypted gallery and organize them into albums.
- AES-256 encryption — every file is strongly encrypted; decryption happens only in memory.
- Biometric unlock — open the vault with fingerprint or face authentication.
- Encrypted backups — create and restore encrypted backups of the vault.
- Auto-delete originals (Android) — optionally remove source files after import.
- Share & export — export files on your own terms; on Android, also share into the vault from other apps.
- Hide the app icon (Android) — optionally remove the launcher icon for extra discretion.
- Intruder warnings (Photok Pro, Android) — opt-in; takes a camera photo on a failed unlock attempt, stored locally only and never transmitted.

## Download

- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6824465126): the iOS app.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.leonlatsch.photok): includes optional Photok Pro in-app purchase.
- [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/dev.leonlatsch.photok/): fully open-source build, analytics off by default.
- [IzzyOnDroid](https://apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/index/apk/dev.leonlatsch.photok): third-party F-Droid repository.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/leonlatsch/Photok/releases/latest): signed APKs directly from the project.
